scale.role: everything else: nav, pills, job rows, body

taste.name: One size, three inks
taste.trigger: When ranking nav, filters, job listings and captions on a page whose images are loud
taste.decision: Chose a single 13px Inter size for 57 of 60 text nodes and ranked text by black opacity (#0B0B0B / 48.6% / 26.7%) over a multi-step type scale
taste.reason: Because every text size step is a new thing for the eye to land on; holding size constant keeps the interface reading as one quiet label layer under the work
evidence: text colours oklch(0 0 0 / .486) x31 and / .267 x3

taste.name: Colour is spent once
taste.trigger: When the chrome needs a highlight for a new section
taste.decision: Chose one hot pink (#F900A3) on the single word "new" over a brand accent on buttons, pills and links
taste.reason: Because a colour that appears only once is read as news; spread across controls it would become decoration and lose that meaning
evidence: active filter pill is #0B0B0B fill, inactive #F5F5F5

taste.name: Feedback in 120 ms, always the same curve
taste.trigger: When pills, rows and image buttons change on hover and focus
taste.decision: Chose one 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) for colour, border and shadow, and 180ms for opacity, with :focus-visible and prefers-reduced-motion both handled, over per-component timing or no transitions
taste.reason: Because a response that arrives in about one frame-cycle of attention feels like the control itself reacting, not an animation playing

taste.name: Community proof as a dated count
taste.trigger: When asking a visitor to sign up from the sidebar
taste.decision: Chose an exact, time-stamped number with a stack of real avatars ("Join 31,832 members, including 270 who signed up yesterday") over a rounded claim or logos
taste.reason: Because a specific figure tied to yesterday proves the place is alive now; a round claim could have been written years ago
evidence: 13px #838383 line under a #0B0B0B pill Sign up button
count badges (24px circles) on multi-image cards: 3, 4
